purpose: 使用 Sellars–Tegart–Garofalo (STG) 模型描述稳态应力，将稳态应力表达为温度补偿应变率的函数。

symbols.meaning: material constant of the equivalent thermal component for steady-state stress (稳态应力对应的等效热分量材料常数)
temperature-compensated strain rate at steady-state point (温度补偿应变率)
thermally activated coefficient for steady-state stress (热激活系数)
thermally activated exponent for steady-state stress (热激活指数)
deformation activation energy at steady-state point (稳态应力点处的变形激活能)
universal gas constant (通用气体常数)

unmapped: 下标 o 和 ss 分别指屈服应力和稳态应力；其中本公式使用 ss 下标对应稳态应力。
